Class ProjectsAPI

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.projects.api.ProjectsAPI
public final class ProjectsAPI extends Object
Town projects, for other plugins: what is being built, how far each is, and when one changes state (Tempest Town unlocks features when a building is finished). Declare "AtomicTempest:Projects": "*" under OptionalDependencies in your manifest.json, keep the classes that touch this one apart from the rest, and check isAvailable() first, so your plugin still loads without Projects.

Everything here may be called from any thread. Answers are copies made when a project last changed, so they never wait for the builder.
